query: SELECT s.id AS series_id, s.canonical_title AS series_title, count(ss.id) AS "source_count!" FROM series s LEFT JOIN series_sources ss ON ss.series_id = s.id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sync_mappings sm WHERE sm.series_id = s.id AND sm.provider = $1) AND ($2::text IS NULL OR s.canonical_title ILIKE $2) GROUP BY s.id, s.canonical_title ORDER BY count(ss.id) DESC, s.canonical_title LIMIT $3
